tools.name: addWatchlistProduct
tools.description: Add a listing to the signed-in user's watchlist by productListingId so they can follow it and, with notifications on (the default), hear about changes. A listing already on the watchlist returns CONFLICT; subscription tier limits apply.

tools.name: createUserAddress
tools.description: Save a new private address with a label and its location in the signed-in user's address book; Aura Historia resolves the location for shipping estimates. Each call creates a new address, so repeating a call that timed out can create a duplicate.

tools.name: createUserSearchFilter
tools.description: Save a listing search for the signed-in user. Aura Historia matches new listings against it in the background and, with notifications on (the default), notifies the user, so matches appear later. Subscription tier limits apply. Each call creates a new saved search, so repeating a call that timed out

tools.name: deleteNotification
tools.description: Permanently delete one of the signed-in user's notifications by notificationId. Returns an empty object; an unknown ID returns NOT_FOUND.

tools.name: deleteNotifications
tools.description: Permanently delete every notification of the signed-in user, including those beyond the listed page. Takes no arguments. Returns an empty object.

tools.name: deleteUserAddress
tools.description: Permanently delete one of the signed-in user's saved addresses. expectedVersion must equal its current version. If the address is the browsing destination, that destination is cleared too. Returns an empty object.

tools.name: deleteUserSearchFilter
tools.description: Permanently delete one of the signed-in user's saved searches. Returns an empty object; an unknown ID returns NOT_FOUND.

tools.name: deleteWatchlistProduct
tools.description: Remove a listing from the signed-in user's watchlist by productListingId. Returns an empty object; a listing that is not on the watchlist returns NOT_FOUND, also after an earlier call removed it.

tools.name: discoverPartyLocations
tools.description: Find the public locations, such as shops and showrooms, of the dealers and auction houses that Aura Historia indexes, within countries or subdivisions or within a radius around a point. Returns each location's business, label, country, coordinates and precision, and with distanceOrder its distance f

tools.name: getAuction
tools.description: Get one auction by its auctionId: name, provider, format, schedule, reported status, reported and visible lot counts, and the link to its catalogue at the provider.

tools.name: getAuctionCatalogue
tools.description: List the lots of one auction by its auctionId in catalogue order, as listings in the requested language and currency with shipping details. Pass the returned searchAfter object as a JSON string to get the next page. For a signed-in user, each result also carries userState sections for which the toke

tools.name: getBrowsingDestination
tools.description: Get the destination Aura Historia uses to estimate shipping while the signed-in user browses: NONE, one of their saved addresses (ADDRESS) or a country with an optional postal code (COUNTRY_POSTAL), with its version.

tools.name: getProductListing
tools.description: Get the full details of one listing by its productListingId: text, prices, images, provider, availability, auction and shipping, in the requested language and currency. Use it when the user wants more than a search result shows. For a signed-in user, each result also carries userState sections for w

tools.name: getProductListingByTitleSlug
tools.description: Get the full details of one listing by its productListingTitleSlugId, the last segment of an Aura Historia listing page URL (/products/{slug}). Returns the same details as the lookup by productListingId. For a signed-in user, each result also carries userState sections for which the token has the re

tools.name: getProductListingHistory
tools.description: Get the complete history of one listing by its productListingId: when it was first seen and every recorded change, in event order. Use it for questions about price development or past changes. With currency, each price is also converted at the exchange rate of its event. Returns every event in one r

tools.name: getPublicListingSourceBySlug
tools.description: Get the public profile of one provider (a dealer, auction house, marketplace or auction platform) by its listingSourceSlugId, the last segment of an Aura Historia provider page URL (/shops/{slug}): name, operator, website and image.

tools.name: getPublicOverview
tools.description: Get the latest calculated statistics of the Aura Historia catalogue: live listings, listings added in the last seven days, countries, languages and indexed providers by type, with the time they were calculated. Takes no arguments.

tools.name: getSimilarProductListings
tools.description: Find listings similar to one listing, identified by its productListingId. Returns up to a fixed number of neighbours in the requested language and currency. EMBEDDING_PENDING means the listing is not yet prepared for comparison and a later call can succeed; READY with an empty list means nothing sim

tools.name: getUserAccount
tools.description: Get the signed-in user's Aura Historia account: email, name, language, currency and measurement unit, content preference, marketing consent, subscription tier and role.

tools.name: getUserAddress
tools.description: Get one of the signed-in user's saved addresses by addressId, with its resolved location and the attribution of the geocoding provider.

tools.name: getUserSearchFilter
tools.description: Get one of the signed-in user's saved searches by userSearchFilterId, with its criteria, state and notification settings.

tools.name: getUserSearchFilters
tools.description: List all of the signed-in user's saved searches with their criteria, state and notification settings. Takes no arguments.

tools.name: getWatchlistProductListings
tools.description: List the listings on the signed-in user's watchlist with their full details and notification settings, in the requested language and currency. Pass the returned searchAfter array as a JSON string to get the next page.

tools.name: listAuctions
tools.description: List auctions of the auction houses and platforms that Aura Historia indexes, filtered by provider, format, reported status and schedule period and sorted by creation or schedule time. Use it to find upcoming, running or past auctions. A schedule period needs timeRole, from and to together, and sort

tools.name: listNotifications
tools.description: List the signed-in user's notifications, such as watchlist changes and new saved-search matches, with each listing as it was when notified, in the requested language. Returns up to size notifications (default 21, 1 to 100); pass the returned searchAfter array as a JSON string to get the next page.

tools.name: listSearchFilterMatches
tools.description: List the listings that matched one of the signed-in user's saved searches, oldest match first, in the requested language and currency. Matching runs in the background, so an empty first page means there are no matches yet. Returns up to size matches (default 21, 1 to 100); pass the returned searchAf

tools.name: listUserAddresses
tools.description: List the signed-in user's saved addresses with their resolved locations. Returns up to limit addresses (default 25, 1 to 100); pass the returned next as after to get the next page.

tools.name: patchWatchlistProduct
tools.description: Turn notifications for a watched listing on or off, or pause (INACTIVE_BY_USER) or resume (ACTIVE) the entry. Omitted fields stay unchanged and null is invalid; resuming is subject to subscription tier limits. Returns the listing with its full details in the requested language and currency.

tools.name: searchPublicListingSources
tools.description: Search the providers whose listings Aura Historia indexes (dealers, auction houses, marketplaces and auction platforms) by name. Without a query it browses all providers; a query too short to match returns no results. Returns 1 to 50 providers per page (default 21); pass the returned searchAfter unc

tools.name: setBrowsingDestination
tools.description: Set or clear the destination used to estimate shipping while the signed-in user browses: NONE clears it, ADDRESS selects one of their saved addresses and COUNTRY_POSTAL a country with an optional postal code. expectedVersion must equal the current version. Returns the new destination and version.

tools.name: simpleSearchProductListings
tools.description: Search Aura Historia's index of art, antiques and design objects listed by dealers, auction houses, marketplaces and auction platforms. Use it to find listings by text and by filters such as price, dates, availability, provider, auction, location and shipping. Returns listing summaries in the reques

tools.name: updateAllNotificationsSeen
tools.description: Mark every notification of the signed-in user as seen or unseen, including those beyond the listed page. Returns an empty object.

tools.name: updateNotificationSeen
tools.description: Mark one of the signed-in user's notifications as seen or unseen by notificationId. Returns an empty object; an unknown ID returns NOT_FOUND.

tools.name: updateNotificationsSeen
tools.description: Mark the signed-in user's notifications with the given notificationIds (at least one) as seen or unseen. Unknown IDs are ignored. Returns an empty object.

tools.name: updateSearchFilterMatchFeedback
tools.description: Record whether a listing that matched one of the signed-in user's saved searches is relevant: true or false sets the feedback, null clears it and omission keeps it. Returns the match; a listing that is not a current match returns NOT_FOUND.

tools.name: updateUserAccount
tools.description: Update the signed-in user's name, language, currency, measurement unit or whether unassessed or sensitive content is shown. Omitted fields stay unchanged and null clears an optional field; the content preference cannot be null. Returns the updated account.

tools.name: updateUserAddress
tools.description: Replace the label and location of one of the signed-in user's saved addresses. expectedVersion must equal the address's current version; a stale version returns CONFLICT. Returns the updated address.

tools.name: updateUserSearchFilter
tools.description: Change the name, criteria, state or notification setting of one of the signed-in user's saved searches. Omitted fields stay unchanged and null clears fields that can be cleared; availability, orderability and includeUnspecifiedAvailability change together. Matching against new criteria runs in the b

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "v1" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: createUserSearchFilter, getAuctionCatalogue, getProductListing, getProductListingByTitleSlug, getPublicListingSourceBySlug, getSimilarProductListings, getUserAccount, getUserSearchFilter, getUserSearchFilters, getWatchlistProductListings, listNotifications, simpleSearchProductListings, updateUserSearchFilter · Private data: createUserAddress, getAuctionCatalogue, getProductListing, getProductListingByTitleSlug, getSimilarProductListings, simpleSearchProductListings, updateSearchFilterMatchFeedback · Public sink: getUserAccount · Destructive: deleteNotification, deleteNotifications, deleteUserAddress, deleteUserSearchFilter, deleteWatchlistProduct, getAuction, listAuctions.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: createUserSearchFilter, getAuctionCatalogue, getProductListing, getProductListingByTitleSlug, getPublicListingSourceBySlug, getSimilarProductListings, getUserAccount, getUserSearchFilter, getUserSearchFilters, getWatchlistProductListings, listNotifications, simpleSearchProductListings, updateUserSearchFilter · Private data: createUserAddress, getAuctionCatalogue, getProductListing, getProductListingByTitleSlug, getSimilarProductListings, simpleSearchProductListings, updateSearchFilterMatchFeedback · Public sink: getUserAccount · Destructive: deleteNotification, deleteNotifications, deleteUserAddress, deleteUserSearchFilter, deleteWatchlistProduct, getAuction, listAuctions

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
